question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A person who rules with absolute power and authority
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dictator"** refers to a person who rules with absolute power and authority. (तानाशाह)

 
 
• **Example:** The dictator imposed strict laws on the citizens without any parliamentary approval.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Senator** (सेनाटर): A member of a senate.

 
 
• **Example:** The senator proposed a new bill in the legislative assembly.
 
 
 
• **Sovereign** (सार्वभौम): A supreme ruler, especially a monarch.
 
 
• **Example:** The sovereign presided over the kingdom with great dignity.
 
 
 
• "Ruler" refers to a person who governs or leads a country or region. (शासक)
 
 
• Example: The ruler of the kingdom was known for his wisdom and fairness.
